author: Nuon Bonong
changelog: Grade 12 Worksheets, Quizzes, & Question Bank complete upgrade: audited all mathematical typesetting across Grade 12 Basic (course-math-g12-basic: 7 chapters, 15 lessons, 46 points) and Advanced (course-math-g12-advanced: 10 chapters, 27 lessons, 74 points) covering 39 unique lessons and 110 unique points (zero raw slash fractions, standardized \dfrac, fixed \ldots and KaTeX math delimiters, converted currency signs to \text{ ដុល្លារ}); upgraded all 110 points with 3 distinct difficulty levels (កម្រិត ១: ស្រួល / មូលដ្ឋានគ្រឹះ, កម្រិត ២: មធ្យម / ការយល់ដឹង និងអនុវត្ត, កម្រិត ៣: ពិបាក / គិតស៊ីជម្រៅ និងដោះស្រាយបញ្ហា) totaling 330 comprehensive exercises with step-by-step teacher solutions, rubrics, and dynamic score calculation (/ ៣); audited 39 point quiz lessons and 1045 question bank questions for zero math errors; verified 100% data integrity for all other grades (7, 8, 9, 10, 11); complete coverage across all 6 grades (7-12) with 547 total points and 1641 total exercises.
